Name: CC - Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues
Author: MolaMole
Description:
[center]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bw1KK9Zd/OCC.png[/img][/center]
[center][/center]
Here is a [i]Catalogue[/i] to gather all no Furniture -main purpose decoration or esthetic- mods of Mole ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ (Me! Mole) with 3 styles and 4 swatches to choose -It only change the estetic, you only need one!-.
It's related to the following mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33634]Molamole's PlayGround[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34622]Molamole's Park Benches[/url] (no available, yet orz) and more.

There Are...:
[list]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues[/b][b]:[/b] Style A -[i] Mole's Choice[/i][/*]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues[/b][b]:[/b] Style B - [i]Modern[/i][/*]
[*][b][CP] Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues: [/b]Style C[i] - [i]Classic[/i][/i][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][Where you can find it?][/size][/b]
[b]Robin Shop[/b] or -and beg you- [b]Krobus.[/b] [b][s][size=3]

[ Known issues][/size][/s][/b]
None (for now), leave a comment if there's any problem!

[center][size=2][b][size=4][b]IMPORTANT: [/b][/size][size=4][b]
You need have [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿﻿] and [size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] Mod.
besides the Furniture Mod you like to have from Mole.[/b][/size][/b][/size]
-[size=2][b]
Mole only upload Mods on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/][/url][size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size],
If you find them in other places, were submit without my knowledge
and I can't guarantee the safety of the file. 
Be careful there![/b][/size][/b][/size][/center]

[center]
[i]---------------- [ESP] ----------------[/i][/center]
[center]

﻿﻿[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vBZkxR3r/OCC-02.png[/img][/center]
[center][url=https://i.postimg.cc/G2j12WMY/002.png]
[/url]﻿Aquí un catalogo para todos los NoMuebles -que no funcionen como muebles, o lo sean con funciones proncipalmente esteticas- del topo ᕕ( ᐛ )ᕗ (mi!) con 3 estilos y 4 texturas para cada - solo cambia la estética del catalogo, solo necesitas tener descargado uno- relacionado a los siguientes mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33634]Molamole's PlayGround[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34622]Molamole's Park Benches[/url] [i](aun no disponibles orz) y otros más.[/i][/center]

Actualmente hay...:
[list]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues[/b][b]:[/b] Style A -[i] Elección topal[/i][/*]
[*][b][CP][/b] [b]Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues[/b][b]:[/b] Style B -[i] Moderno[/i][/*]
[*][b][CP] Molamole's Old Furniture Catalogues: [/b]Style C[i] - [i]Clasico[/i][/i][/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3][Donde se encuentra?][/size][/b]
[b]La tienda de Robin[/b] -y por favor, lo sugiero encarecidamente-[b] Krobus. [/b]

[center][b][s][size=3][ Problemas conocidos ][/size][/s][/b]
Ninguno (por ahora), deja un comentario si encuentras alguno!

[size=4][b]IMPORTANTE:
[size=2][b][size=4][b]You need have [[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20628]Calcifer[/url]﻿﻿] and [size=4][b][[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]] Mod.
ademas de los Mods de la topa que quieras tener en el catalogo.[/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][/b][/size][size=3][size=3][b][b]
-[/b][/b][/size][/size]
[size=3][size=3][b][b][size=2]La Topa solo sube Mods en la página de [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/thisweek/]Nexus[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]C[/url][url=https://www.curseforge.com/members/molamole/projects]urseForge[/url]﻿﻿!
Si los encuentras en otra página, fueron re-subidos sin mi conocimiento
y no puedo asegurar la integridad del archivo.
Tengan cuidado por allí![/size][/b][/b][/size][/size][/center]
